event.text: Interpreting element geometry and trim operations for a corner joint between two segments.

event.understanding: Transom 60x120 end overlaps Mullion 60x120 by 30 mm at a curtain-wall corner joint. This is a modelling connection overlap, not a routing clash, and the mullion should normally stay continuous. The fix is a connection trim, not a move.

options.title: Trim transom end to mullion face
options.rationale: Transom frames into continuous mullion, so cutting the 60 mm overrun back to butt at the mullion face preserves both members.
options.also_needs: transom end cleat or screw connection

event.advice: Accept the transom trim as the standard curtain-wall joint; architectural modeller to correct the joint connection so the transom butts the mullion face.
